notes.title: Community Item “Animated Avatars” Released!
notes.content: [p]New Animated Avatars featuring characters from Absented Age are now available as Community Items![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy them together with the game![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/3550640"]https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/3550640[/url][/p][p][/p][p]New Characters in Absented Age 2:[/p][p]・Mika[/p][p]・Akane[/p][p]・Komaki[/p][p]・Minami[/p][p]・Rumi[/p][p][/p][p]Characters previously added in Absented Age Squarebound[/p][p]・Karen[/p][p]・Hayato[/p][p]・Suzu[/p][p]・Tarte[/p][p][/p][p]Choose your favorite character and join in making the community even more exciting![/p]
